title: Bea, Mas Malaking Pabor
setup: May malaking exam bukas at hindi pa rin nakapag-review si Bea. 'Isang beses na lang, please. Pag hindi ako pumasa, lagot ako kay Nanay.'
setup_en: There's a big exam tomorrow and Bea still hasn't reviewed. 'Just one more time, please. If I fail, Nanay will be furious.'

choices.label: Hindi. Pero tutulungan kitang mag-review ngayon.
choices.label_en: No. But I'll help you review now.

fail.text: Pagod kayong dalawa, pero sinubukan mo.
fail.text_en: You're both exhausted, but you tried.

choices.label: Hindi ko 'yan pipirmahan.
choices.label_en: I won't sign off on that.

success.text: Naiintindihan ka ni Bea, kahit nasaktan.

fail.text: Nagalit si Bea. Nasaktan ang samahan.
fail.text_en: Bea is angry. The bond is hurt.
